description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of content categories within a dataset, likely representing the composition of videos used for training or analysis. The chart contains 12 slices, each representing a different content category. These categories are, in clockwise order starting from the largest slice: People/Blogs at 17.2%, Education at 13.9%, Film/Animation at 7.7%, Sports at 6.4%, Gaming at 6.4%, Travel/Events at 4.6%, Comedy at 4.6%, Science/Technology at 4.8%, News/Politics at 2.3%, Pets/Animals at 4.3%, Autos/Vehicles at 4.3%, and Music at 9.7%. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest proportion, visually. A legend is present, labeling each category with its corresponding color.
